title: permittimelines: Garage-Conversion and ADU Building Permit Timeline Data for Four U.S. Cities
description:
64,427 residential garage-to-ADU and garage-to-habitable-room conversion permit applications for Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, and Seattle, with measured application-to-issuance waits, application-year cohort completion rates, and small-cell-suppressed timeline aggregates. Prepared from each city's official open-data portal with a committed, dependency-free build script. Distributed as an R package with Python loaders; the prepared data files are CC BY 4.0 and the code is MIT.

Method rules: cohorts are formed on the application year, never the issue year; records are deduplicated on the permit number; review tracks are never pooled; aggregate cells under 30 records are suppressed; only city-years with roughly 75 percent of applications resolved enter the aggregates. The measured wait is the homeowner's calendar wait, not a statutory compliance measure.
